Alger, 12 septembre 2026 (Algeria Tech): Algiers, September 12, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — Global mobility platform inDrive has announced the integration of new features into its passenger app. These updates aim to offer users greater clarity at every stage of their journey.
Modernisation de l'interface et optimisa: Interface modernization and user experience optimization
La plateforme globale de services de mob: The global mobility and delivery services platform inDrive is introducing several interactive tools to meet the expectations of its passengers. Specifically, users want better tariff transparency, an estimated wait time, and precise driver information. To design these developments, the company relied on internal surveys and the analysis of user feedback.
L'application intègre désormais un indic: The app now incorporates a color-coded price indicator to guide users when suggesting a fare. Green indicates that the proposed amount is close to the recommended rate, maximizing the chances of quickly securing a driver. Conversely, orange or red indicates a lower fare, which may reduce the number of offers and lengthen the wait time.
De plus, en période de forte affluence,: Additionally, during peak periods, the app explicitly displays temporary increases in recommended fares directly on the ordering screen. To limit cancellations linked to uncertainty, dynamic statuses indicate in real-time the number of available drivers nearby and those viewing the request. Finally, the system now prompts passengers to specify the reason for canceling their ride.
Intégration d'un indicateur coloré (vert: Integration of a color-coded indicator (green, orange, red) to assess the impact of the proposed price on wait time.
Affichage explicite des hausses de tarif: Explicit display of temporary fare increases related to periods of high travel demand.
Introduction de statuts dynamiques montr: Introduction of dynamic statuses showing in real-time the number of available and connected drivers for the request.
Collecte des motifs d'annulation pour id: Collection of cancellation reasons to identify user entry or category errors.
